parameters.query:
WITH selected_user AS (
    SELECT
        u.userid,
        u.fname,
        u.lname,
        u.lastrequest
    FROM public."User" u
    WHERE u.userid = $2
),

selected_usecase AS (
    SELECT
        uc.usecase_id,
        uc.name,
        uc.description
    FROM public."UseCase" uc
    WHERE uc.usecase_id = $1
),

participant_events AS (
    SELECT
        sd.id AS sensor_data_id,
        sd.userid,
        sd.usecase_id,
        sd.value,
        sd.time,
        sd.alertid,

        a.alertgiven,
        a.intensity,
        a.pulses,
        a.duration,
        a."interval" AS vibration_interval,
        a.type AS alert_type,
        a.fbrangeid,
        a.vibration_reason

    FROM public."SensorData" sd

    LEFT JOIN public."Alert" a
      ON a.alertid = sd.alertid

    WHERE sd.userid = $2
      AND sd.usecase_id = $1
      AND sd.time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
),

participant_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::integer AS total_readings,

        ROUND(
            MIN(pe.value)::numeric,
            2
        ) AS min_seen,

        ROUND(
            MAX(pe.value)::numeric,
            2
        ) AS max_seen,

        ROUND(
            AVG(pe.value)::numeric,
            2
        ) AS avg_seen,

        ROUND(
            STDDEV_POP(pe.value)::numeric,
            2
        ) AS stddev_seen,

        ROUND(
            PERCENTILE_CONT(0.10)
            WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pe.value)::numeric,
            2
        ) AS p10_seen,

        ROUND(
            PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50)
            WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pe.value)::numeric,
            2
        ) AS median_seen,

        ROUND(
            PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90)
            WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pe.value)::numeric,
            2
        ) AS p90_seen,

        MIN(pe.time) AS first_reading_at,
        MAX(pe.time) AS last_reading_at,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT pe.time::date
        )::integer AS active_days

    FROM participant_events pe
),

recent_7d_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::integer AS total_readings,

        ROUND(
            MIN(pe.value)::numeric,
            2
        ) AS min_seen,

        ROUND(
            MAX(pe.value)::numeric,
            2
        ) AS max_seen,

        ROUND(
            AVG(pe.value)::numeric,
            2
        ) AS avg_seen,

        ROUND(
            PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50)
            WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pe.value)::numeric,
            2
        ) AS median_seen,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT pe.time::date
        )::integer AS active_days

    FROM participant_events pe

    WHERE pe.time >=
          NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
),

daily_feedback AS (
    SELECT
        pe.time::date AS event_date,

        COUNT(*)::integer AS readings,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE pe.alertgiven = 'yes'
        )::integer AS feedback_events,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE pe.fbrangeid = 9999
        )::integer AS fallback_events

    FROM participant_events pe

    GROUP BY pe.time::date
),

feedback_summary AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::integer AS sensor_event_rows,

        COUNT(pe.alertid)::integer AS alert_records,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE pe.alertgiven = 'yes'
        )::integer AS feedback_events,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE pe.alertgiven = 'no'
        )::integer AS no_feedback_events,

        ROUND(
            (
                100.0 *
                COUNT(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE pe.alertgiven = 'yes'
                ) /
                NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)
            )::numeric,
            2
        ) AS feedback_event_rate_percent,

        ROUND(
            (
                COUNT(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE pe.alertgiven = 'yes'
                )::numeric /
                NULLIF(
                    COUNT(DISTINCT pe.time::date),
                    0
                )
            ),
            2
        ) AS feedback_events_per_active_day,

        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT MAX(df.feedback_events)
                FROM daily_feedback df
            ),
            0
        )::integer AS max_feedback_events_in_day,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE pe.fbrangeid = 9999
        )::integer AS fallback_event_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE pe.vibration_reason = 'rate_limited'
        )::integer AS rate_limited_count,

        COUNT(DISTINCT pe.fbrangeid) FILTER (
            WHERE pe.fbrangeid IS NOT NULL
        )::integer AS distinct_mapping_ids_used,

        ROUND(
            (
                AVG(pe.pulses) FILTER (
                    WHERE pe.alertgiven = 'yes'
                )
            )::numeric,
            2
        ) AS avg_pulses,

        ROUND(
            (
                AVG(pe.intensity) FILTER (
                    WHERE pe.alertgiven = 'yes'
                )
            )::numeric,
            2
        ) AS avg_intensity,

        ROUND(
            (
                AVG(pe.duration) FILTER (
                    WHERE pe.alertgiven = 'yes'
                )
            )::numeric,
            2
        ) AS avg_duration,

        ROUND(
            (
                AVG(pe.vibration_interval) FILTER (
                    WHERE pe.alertgiven = 'yes'
                )
            )::numeric,
            2
        ) AS avg_interval

    FROM participant_events pe
),

cohort_events AS (
    SELECT
        sd.userid,
        sd.value,
        sd.time,
        a.alertgiven

    FROM public."SensorData" sd

    LEFT JOIN public."Alert" a
      ON a.alertid = sd.alertid

    WHERE sd.usecase_id = $1
      AND sd.time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
),

cohort_summary AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::integer AS total_readings,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT ce.userid
        )::integer AS participant_count,

        ROUND(
            AVG(ce.value)::numeric,
            2
        ) AS avg_seen,

        ROUND(
            STDDEV_POP(ce.value)::numeric,
            2
        ) AS stddev_seen,

        ROUND(
            PERCENTILE_CONT(0.10)
            WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ce.value)::numeric,
            2
        ) AS p10_seen,

        ROUND(
            PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50)
            WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ce.value)::numeric,
            2
        ) AS median_seen,

        ROUND(
            PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90)
            WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ce.value)::numeric,
            2
        ) AS p90_seen,

        ROUND(
            (
                100.0 *
                COUNT(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE ce.alertgiven = 'yes'
                ) /
                NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)
            )::numeric,
            2
        ) AS feedback_event_rate_percent

    FROM cohort_events ce
),

global_active_assignment AS (
    SELECT
        jsonb_build_object(
            'assignment_id', uum.id,
            'user_id', uum.user_id,
            'mapping_id',
                uum.feedback_config_rule_id,
            'active', uum.active,
            'assigned_at', uum.assigned_at,
            'deactivated_at',
                uum.deactivated_at,

            'mapping', jsonb_build_object(
                'id', fcr.id,
                'type', fcr.type,
                'usecase_id', fcr.usecase_id,
                'usecase_name', mapping_uc.name,

                'minvalue', fcr.minvalue,
                'maxvalue', fcr.maxvalue,
                'minpulses', fcr.minpulses,
                'maxpulses', fcr.maxpulses,
                'minintensity', fcr.minintensity,
                'maxintensity', fcr.maxintensity,
                'minduration', fcr.minduration,
                'maxduration', fcr.maxduration,
                'mininterval', fcr.mininterval,
                'maxinterval', fcr.maxinterval
            )
        ) AS assignment

    FROM public."User_UC_Mappings" uum

    JOIN public.feedback_config_rules fcr
      ON fcr.id =
         uum.feedback_config_rule_id

    LEFT JOIN public."UseCase" mapping_uc
      ON mapping_uc.usecase_id =
         fcr.usecase_id

    WHERE uum.user_id = $2
      AND uum.active = true

    ORDER BY
        uum.assigned_at DESC NULLS LAST,
        uum.id DESC

    LIMIT 1
),

assignment_history_rows AS (
    SELECT
        uum.id AS assignment_id,
        uum.user_id,
        uum.feedback_config_rule_id
            AS mapping_id,
        uum.active,
        uum.assigned_at,
        uum.deactivated_at,

        fcr.type AS mapping_type,
        fcr.usecase_id,
        history_uc.name AS usecase_name,

        fcr.minvalue,
        fcr.maxvalue,
        fcr.minpulses,
        fcr.maxpulses,
        fcr.minintensity,
        fcr.maxintensity,
        fcr.minduration,
        fcr.maxduration,
        fcr.mininterval,
        fcr.maxinterval

    FROM public."User_UC_Mappings" uum

    JOIN public.feedback_config_rules fcr
      ON fcr.id =
         uum.feedback_config_rule_id

    LEFT JOIN public."UseCase" history_uc
      ON history_uc.usecase_id =
         fcr.usecase_id

    WHERE uum.user_id = $2
      AND fcr.usecase_id = $1
),

assignment_history AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::integer AS history_count,

        COALESCE(
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'assignment_id',
                        ahr.assignment_id,
                    'mapping_id',
                        ahr.mapping_id,
                    'active',
                        ahr.active,
                    'assigned_at',
                        ahr.assigned_at,
                    'deactivated_at',
                        ahr.deactivated_at,

                    'mapping', jsonb_build_object(
                        'id',
                            ahr.mapping_id,
                        'type',
                            ahr.mapping_type,
                        'usecase_id',
                            ahr.usecase_id,
                        'usecase_name',
                            ahr.usecase_name,
                        'minvalue',
                            ahr.minvalue,
                        'maxvalue',
                            ahr.maxvalue,
                        'minpulses',
                            ahr.minpulses,
                        'maxpulses',
                            ahr.maxpulses,
                        'minintensity',
                            ahr.minintensity,
                        'maxintensity',
                            ahr.maxintensity,
                        'minduration',
                            ahr.minduration,
                        'maxduration',
                            ahr.maxduration,
                        'mininterval',
                            ahr.mininterval,
                        'maxinterval',
                            ahr.maxinterval
                    )
                )

                ORDER BY
                    ahr.assigned_at DESC NULLS LAST,
                    ahr.assignment_id DESC
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        ) AS items

    FROM assignment_history_rows ahr
),

mapping_usage_rows AS (
    SELECT
        pe.fbrangeid AS mapping_id,

        COUNT(*)::integer AS event_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE pe.alertgiven = 'yes'
        )::integer AS feedback_events,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE pe.alertgiven = 'no'
        )::integer AS no_feedback_events,

        MIN(pe.time) AS first_used_at,
        MAX(pe.time) AS last_used_at

    FROM participant_events pe

    WHERE pe.fbrangeid IS NOT NULL

    GROUP BY pe.fbrangeid
),

mapping_usage AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'mapping_id',
                        mur.mapping_id,
                    'event_rows',
                        mur.event_rows,
                    'feedback_events',
                        mur.feedback_events,
                    'no_feedback_events',
                        mur.no_feedback_events,
                    'first_used_at',
                        mur.first_used_at,
                    'last_used_at',
                        mur.last_used_at,

                    'mapping', jsonb_build_object(
                        'id',
                            fcr.id,
                        'type',
                            fcr.type,
                        'usecase_id',
                            fcr.usecase_id,
                        'minvalue',
                            fcr.minvalue,
                        'maxvalue',
                            fcr.maxvalue,
                        'minpulses',
                            fcr.minpulses,
                        'maxpulses',
                            fcr.maxpulses,
                        'minintensity',
                            fcr.minintensity,
                        'maxintensity',
                            fcr.maxintensity,
                        'minduration',
                            fcr.minduration,
                        'maxduration',
                            fcr.maxduration,
                        'mininterval',
                            fcr.mininterval,
                        'maxinterval',
                            fcr.maxinterval
                    )
                )

                ORDER BY
                    mur.event_rows DESC,
                    mur.mapping_id
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        ) AS items

    FROM mapping_usage_rows mur

    LEFT JOIN public.feedback_config_rules fcr
      ON fcr.id = mur.mapping_id
)

SELECT
    su.userid AS user_id,
    su.fname,
    su.lname,
    su.lastrequest,

    uc.usecase_id,
    uc.name AS usecase_name,
    uc.description AS usecase_description,

    jsonb_build_object(
        'window_days', 30,
        'total_readings',
            ps.total_readings,
        'active_days',
            ps.active_days,
        'min_seen',
            ps.min_seen,
        'max_seen',
            ps.max_seen,
        'avg_seen',
            ps.avg_seen,
        'stddev_seen',
            ps.stddev_seen,
        'p10_seen',
            ps.p10_seen,
        'median_seen',
            ps.median_seen,
        'p90_seen',
            ps.p90_seen,
        'first_reading_at',
            ps.first_reading_at,
        'last_reading_at',
            ps.last_reading_at
    ) AS participant_stats,

    jsonb_build_object(
        'window_days', 7,
        'total_readings',
            r7.total_readings,
        'active_days',
            r7.active_days,
        'min_seen',
            r7.min_seen,
        'max_seen',
            r7.max_seen,
        'avg_seen',
            r7.avg_seen,
        'median_seen',
            r7.median_seen
    ) AS recent_7d_stats,

    jsonb_build_object(
        'sensor_event_rows',
            fs.sensor_event_rows,
        'alert_records',
            fs.alert_records,
        'feedback_events',
            fs.feedback_events,
        'no_feedback_events',
            fs.no_feedback_events,
        'feedback_event_rate_percent',
            fs.feedback_event_rate_percent,
        'feedback_events_per_active_day',
            fs.feedback_events_per_active_day,
        'max_feedback_events_in_day',
            fs.max_feedback_events_in_day,
        'fallback_event_count',
            fs.fallback_event_count,
        'rate_limited_count',
            fs.rate_limited_count,
        'distinct_mapping_ids_used',
            fs.distinct_mapping_ids_used,
        'avg_pulses',
            fs.avg_pulses,
        'avg_intensity',
            fs.avg_intensity,
        'avg_duration',
            fs.avg_duration,
        'avg_interval',
            fs.avg_interval
    ) AS feedback_summary,

    jsonb_build_object(
        'window_days', 30,
        'participant_count',
            cs.participant_count,
        'total_readings',
            cs.total_readings,
        'avg_seen',
            cs.avg_seen,
        'stddev_seen',
            cs.stddev_seen,
        'p10_seen',
            cs.p10_seen,
        'median_seen',
            cs.median_seen,
        'p90_seen',
            cs.p90_seen,
        'feedback_event_rate_percent',
            cs.feedback_event_rate_percent
    ) AS cohort_summary,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT assignment
            FROM global_active_assignment
        ),
        'null'::jsonb
    ) AS global_active_assignment,

    ah.history_count
        AS assignment_history_count,

    ah.items
        AS assignment_history,

    mu.items
        AS mapping_usage

FROM selected_user su

CROSS JOIN selected_usecase uc
CROSS JOIN participant_stats ps
CROSS JOIN recent_7d_stats r7
CROSS JOIN feedback_summary fs
CROSS JOIN cohort_summary cs
CROSS JOIN assignment_history ah
CROSS JOIN mapping_usage mu;

parameters.text:
={{
"You are the read-only Participant Data Expert for the Smartwatch Haptic research system.\n\n" +

"Your role is to summarize participant-specific sensor data, mapping-assignment history, " +
"and recent vibration-feedback burden. You may identify evidence suggesting that a mapping " +
"should be reviewed, but you must never save, assign, activate, deactivate, create, delete, " +
"or modify a mapping.\n\n" +

"Rules:\n" +
"1. Use only the supplied database context.\n" +
"2. Do not invent readings, feedback events, assignment history, mappings, or participant behavior.\n" +
"3. Do not make medical, diagnostic, clinical, or health-risk claims.\n" +
"4. Heart-rate values must be described only as recorded sensor values, not as evidence of a condition.\n" +
"5. Clearly distinguish direct database observations from interpretation.\n" +
"6. A difference from the cohort does not automatically mean personalization is required.\n" +
"7. When participant data is absent, return data_sufficiency=insufficient and personalization_signal=insufficient_data.\n" +
"8. When participant data is limited, make tentative observations and use low or moderate confidence.\n" +
"9. Feedback burden may be discussed using feedback-event frequency, events per active day, " +
"rate-limiting, fallback use, vibration intensity, pulses, duration, and interval.\n" +
"10. Do not use fixed medical thresholds.\n" +
"11. The system currently supports one globally active mapping per participant. " +
"If that mapping belongs to another use case, describe it as a configuration observation.\n" +
"12. Do not recommend saving or assigning a mapping. Recommend researcher review only.\n" +
"13. Do not include Markdown code fences.\n" +
"14. The reply field must contain an actual summary of the supplied participant context.\n" +
"15. Never copy instructions, placeholder wording, schema descriptions, or example text into the reply.\n" +
"16. The reply must explicitly state that the analysis was read-only and that no records were changed.\n\n" +

"Evidence-reference rules:\n" +
"Use only evidence paths that exist in the supplied context.\n" +
"Valid top-level evidence-path prefixes are:\n" +
"- participant_stats\n" +
"- recent_7d_stats\n" +
"- feedback_summary\n" +
"- cohort_summary\n" +
"- global_active_assignment\n" +
"- assignment_history\n" +
"- mapping_usage\n\n" +

"Examples of valid evidence references:\n" +
"- participant_stats.total_readings\n" +
"- participant_stats.active_days\n" +
"- participant_stats.avg_seen\n" +
"- participant_stats.min_seen\n" +
"- participant_stats.max_seen\n" +
"- recent_7d_stats.total_readings\n" +
"- recent_7d_stats.avg_seen\n" +
"- feedback_summary.alert_records\n" +
"- feedback_summary.feedback_events\n" +
"- feedback_summary.feedback_events_per_active_day\n" +
"- feedback_summary.fallback_event_count\n" +
"- feedback_summary.rate_limited_count\n" +
"- cohort_summary.participant_count\n" +
"- cohort_summary.avg_seen\n" +
"- global_active_assignment.mapping.usecase_id\n" +
"- global_active_assignment.mapping.id\n" +
"- assignment_history\n" +
"- mapping_usage\n\n" +

"Do not rename context objects. For example:\n" +
"- use feedback_summary, not recent_feedback_summary\n" +
"- use global_active_assignment, not current_globally_active_assignment\n\n" +

"Return exactly one valid JSON object using this structure:\n" +
JSON.stringify({
  reply: "",

  warnings: [],

  participant_assessment: {
    data_sufficiency:
      "insufficient | limited | adequate",

    personalization_signal:
      "insufficient_data | no_clear_signal | consider_review",

    feedback_burden_signal:
      "unknown | no_clear_signal | consider_review",

    rationale: [
      "A short reason grounded in the supplied database context"
    ]
  },

  findings: [
    {
      finding_id: "f1",

      category:
        "data_coverage | sensor_pattern | feedback_burden | assignment_history | personalization",

      statement:
        "A concise observation grounded in the supplied context.",

      evidence_refs: [
        "participant_stats.total_readings"
      ],

      confidence:
        "low | moderate | high"
    }
  ],

  recommended_actions: [
    {
      action:
        "collect_more_data | review_personalization | review_feedback_burden | compare_mapping_options",

      label:
        "Researcher-facing action label",

      reason:
        "Why this action follows from the available evidence"
    }
  ]
}, null, 2) +

"\n\nThe reply field above is intentionally empty. " +
"You must replace it with an actual participant-specific summary.\n" +

"\n\nResearcher request:\n" +
$json.message +

"\n\nParticipant and use case:\n" +
JSON.stringify({
  user_id:
    $json.user_id,

  participant_name:
    $json.participant_name,

  usecase_id:
    $json.usecase_id,

  usecase_name:
    $json.usecase_name,

  selected_user_mapping_id:
    $json.selected_user_mapping_id
}, null, 2) +

"\n\nParticipant sensor summary, last 30 days:\n" +
JSON.stringify(
  $json.participant_stats ?? {},
  null,
  2
) +

"\n\nParticipant sensor summary, last 7 days:\n" +
JSON.stringify(
  $json.recent_7d_stats ?? {},
  null,
  2
) +

"\n\nRecent feedback summary:\n" +
JSON.stringify(
  $json.feedback_summary ?? {},
  null,
  2
) +

"\n\nCohort summary for the same use case and 30-day window:\n" +
JSON.stringify(
  $json.cohort_summary ?? {},
  null,
  2
) +

"\n\nCurrent globally active assignment:\n" +
JSON.stringify(
  $json.global_active_assignment ?? null,
  null,
  2
) +

"\n\nAssignment history for the selected participant and use case:\n" +
JSON.stringify(
  $json.assignment_history ?? [],
  null,
  2
) +

"\n\nMapping IDs observed in recent selected-use-case events:\n" +
JSON.stringify(
  $json.mapping_usage ?? [],
  null,
  2
) +

"\n\nAdditional application context:\n" +
JSON.stringify(
  $json.context ?? {},
  null,
  2
) +

"\n\nExisting context warnings:\n" +
JSON.stringify(
  $json.context_warnings ?? [],
  null,
  2
)
}}

parameters.query:
WITH request AS (
    SELECT $1::integer AS usecase_id
),

selected_usecase AS (
    SELECT
        r.usecase_id,
        uc.name,
        uc.description
    FROM request r
    LEFT JOIN public."UseCase" uc
        ON uc.usecase_id = r.usecase_id
),

active_mapping_rows AS (
    SELECT
        fcr.id AS mapping_id,
        fcr.type,
        fcr.minvalue,
        fcr.maxvalue,
        fcr.minpulses,
        fcr.maxpulses,
        fcr.minintensity,
        fcr.maxintensity,
        fcr.minduration,
        fcr.maxduration,
        fcr.mininterval,
        fcr.maxinterval,
        COUNT(DISTINCT uum.user_id)::integer
            AS assigned_user_count
    FROM public.feedback_config_rules fcr
    JOIN public."User_UC_Mappings" uum
        ON uum.feedback_config_rule_id = fcr.id
       AND uum.active = true
    WHERE fcr.usecase_id = (
        SELECT usecase_id
        FROM request
    )
    GROUP BY
        fcr.id,
        fcr.type,
        fcr.minvalue,
        fcr.maxvalue,
        fcr.minpulses,
        fcr.maxpulses,
        fcr.minintensity,
        fcr.maxintensity,
        fcr.minduration,
        fcr.maxduration,
        fcr.mininterval,
        fcr.maxinterval
),

mapping_summary AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::integer AS active_mapping_count,

        COALESCE(
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'mapping_id',
                    mapping_id,

                    'type',
                    type,

                    'minvalue',
                    minvalue,

                    'maxvalue',
                    maxvalue,

                    'minpulses',
                    minpulses,

                    'maxpulses',
                    maxpulses,

                    'minintensity',
                    minintensity,

                    'maxintensity',
                    maxintensity,

                    'minduration',
                    minduration,

                    'maxduration',
                    maxduration,

                    'mininterval',
                    mininterval,

                    'maxinterval',
                    maxinterval,

                    'assigned_user_count',
                    assigned_user_count
                )
                ORDER BY
                    minvalue NULLS LAST,
                    mapping_id
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        ) AS active_mappings
    FROM active_mapping_rows
),

assigned_participant_rows AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        u.userid AS user_id,

        NULLIF(
            BTRIM(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    ' ',
                    u.fname,
                    u.lname
                )
            ),
            ''
        ) AS user_name,

        uum.id AS user_mapping_id,

        fcr.id AS mapping_id

    FROM public."User_UC_Mappings" uum

    JOIN public.feedback_config_rules fcr
        ON fcr.id = uum.feedback_config_rule_id

    JOIN public."User" u
        ON u.userid = uum.user_id

    WHERE uum.active = true
      AND fcr.usecase_id = (
          SELECT usecase_id
          FROM request
      )
),

participant_summary AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::integer
            AS assigned_participant_count,

        COALESCE(
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'user_id',
                    user_id,

                    'user_name',
                    user_name,

                    'user_mapping_id',
                    user_mapping_id,

                    'mapping_id',
                    mapping_id
                )
                ORDER BY user_id
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        ) AS assigned_participants

    FROM assigned_participant_rows
),

sensor_summary AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::integer
            AS total_readings,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT sd.userid
        )::integer
            AS participants_with_readings,

        MIN(sd.value)::numeric
            AS min_sensor_value,

        MAX(sd.value)::numeric
            AS max_sensor_value,

        ROUND(
            AVG(sd.value)::numeric,
            2
        ) AS avg_sensor_value,

        MIN(sd.time)
            AS first_reading_at,

        MAX(sd.time)
            AS latest_reading_at
    FROM public."SensorData" sd
    WHERE sd.usecase_id = (
        SELECT usecase_id
        FROM request
    )
      AND sd.time >=
          NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
),

feedback_summary AS (
    SELECT
        (
            COUNT(*)
            FILTER (
                WHERE sd.alertid IS NOT NULL
            )
        )::integer
            AS feedback_event_count,

        (
            COUNT(
                DISTINCT sd.userid
            )
            FILTER (
                WHERE sd.alertid IS NOT NULL
            )
        )::integer
            AS participants_with_feedback
    FROM public."SensorData" sd
    WHERE sd.usecase_id = (
        SELECT usecase_id
        FROM request
    )
      AND sd.time >=
          NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
)

SELECT
    uc.usecase_id,
    uc.name AS usecase_name,
    uc.description AS usecase_description,

    30::integer AS period_days,

    ps.assigned_participant_count,
  ps.assigned_participants,

    ss.participants_with_readings,
    ss.total_readings,
    ss.min_sensor_value,
    ss.max_sensor_value,
    ss.avg_sensor_value,
    ss.first_reading_at,
    ss.latest_reading_at,

    fs.feedback_event_count,
    fs.participants_with_feedback,

    ms.active_mapping_count,
    ms.active_mappings

FROM selected_usecase uc
CROSS JOIN participant_summary ps
CROSS JOIN sensor_summary ss
CROSS JOIN feedback_summary fs
CROSS JOIN mapping_summary ms;
